description: FR-C1-02. A streaming request sent upstream sets stream_options.include_usage when that upstream supports it. A non-streaming body, or an upstream that does not support usage chunks, is left without that flag. The SSE response is still passed through unchanged.
scope: stream true and supports_usage true sets include_usage
supports_usage false does not add stream_options
acceptanceCriteria: with_stream_usage({stream: true, model: qwen3:8b}, True) returns stream_options.include_usage true and keeps model qwen3:8b. with_stream_usage of the same body and False has no stream_options key. FR-C1-02.
constraints: Do not rewrite SSE response bytes.
Do not add include_usage when supports_usage is false.
Do not drop the model or the messages from the outbound body.
